name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
review: My favorite game ever (still holds as of Oct 2026). I have no history of playing the original ps1 game, but Rebirth was the best game I’ve played. The story, the characters, the combat (holy hot dang!), the minigames… everything the game does it does with so much heart and to such an amazing degree. After beating the game I didn’t have the desire to play any other games for a couple months - it just felt like nothing could compare. I would recommend this game so highly to everyone.
